name: Sole or Cod Pie
author: Isabella Beeton (1861)

source.name: Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management

ingredients.item: The remains of cold boiled sole or cod
1 dozen oysters to each lb of fish
1 teacupful of cream thickened with flour, puff paste

steps: Clear the fish from the bones, lay it in a pie-dish, and between each layer put a few oysters and a little seasoning; add the stock, and, when liked, a small quantity of butter; cover with puff paste, and bake for 1/2 hour.
Boil the cream with sufficient flour to thicken it; pour in the pie, and serve.

culture.text: From Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861) by Isabella Beeton. It was a Victorian best-seller that shaped how British households cooked and ran their kitchens for generations, and it was one of the first cookbooks to list ingredients before the method.
